result.summary: Found 4 visual issues: misaligned carousel card heights in Fastest near you, inconsistent favorite icon styling, low-contrast inactive navigation and search placeholder, and clipped edge content with truncated text.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' row have unequal image heights - Green Bowl Poké image is taller than Smash Bros Burgers, causing time badges and titles/delivery text to sit on uneven baselines
issues.suggestion: Enforce a uniform aspect ratio and fixed height for all horizontal carousel cards so images, badges, and text align

issues.description: Favorite heart icon treatment is inconsistent: Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows white outline directly on image with no background, while the pizza card below shows white outline inside a dark circular scrim
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent scrim or circular background for all overlay favorite icons to ensure visibility and visual consistency

issues.description: Inactive bottom navigation icons/labels for Search, Orders, Profile and the search field placeholder and magnifier are very light grey with low contrast against white
issues.suggestion: Darken inactive icons, labels, and placeholder text to meet minimum color contrast requirements

issues.description: Right-edge content is clipped without clear affordance: far-right category chip is cut in half and the third restaurant card is cut off mid-image with name truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Add proper end padding and intentional card peeking with ellipsis truncation to make horizontal scroll obvious
